reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserved the downstream handoff rows it received and deterministically mapped coverage against the supplied capabilities; the all-none coverage follows from the upstream handoff containing source-id strings as need values, not from a downstream mutation.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Map allowed handoff needs to coverage rows preserving record_id and need.
Map capabilities to needs without changing the incoming need text.

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize consumed coverage and exact provenance, marked non-direct rows unsupported, and ordered all unsupported rows by upstream_rank 1 through 8.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Preserve exact upstream provenance rank from evidence_sources handoff.
Order unsupported needs first and otherwise preserve upstream ranking.

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize retained eight priority records and built the recommendation directly from the first ranked record, yielding decision prioritize and top_need s01 as required by the actual ranked input.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Produce deterministic top-need recommendation from the first ranked record.

reviews.decision_reason: Top root cause: select_demand did not preserve the corpus need field. It selected all eight qualifying demand rows, but wrote need from source_id, producing s01 through s08 instead of the stipulated need text from the corpus. This corrupts the needs handoff before downstream mapping.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Preserve record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight fields.
Do not change stipulated need text.

reviews.decision_reason: normalize preserved the selected rows it received, enforced the allowed record-id set, retained the required columns, and bounded the output to the eight-row window. The need values were already corrupted by select_demand.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Normalize to required columns with neutral sentinels.
Preserve allowed corpus identifiers and bounded index window.

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance produced eight evidence source rows with record_id, source_id, source_weight, and deterministic ranks ordered by demand_score descending and record_id tie-break. The evidence_sources handoff hash matches downstream consumption.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Assemble ranked source provenance with missing-safe field access.
